title: Backdooring Textual Inversion for Concept Censorship
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'concept censorship' for text-to-image models to prevent the generation of content deemed malicious or unethical (e.g., deceptive imagery, sexual content, illegal activities, and shocking content). It evaluates the effectiveness of its method using these ethical and moral categories, particularly through a custom metric called the 'Protection Success Rate' (PSR), which is based on content policies for AI safety.
